title: Manufacturing Engineering
description: Manufacturing Engineering as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are manufacturing processes for each item type identified?
Is the proposed build sequence feasible at the planned Build Stations?
Are any new or unusual manufacturing processes identified?
Are tooling and jigs needs identified?
Are items designed for the selected processes (for example bend radii, machining access)?
Is assembly access confirmed for tools and fasteners?
Are released definitions producible with the selected processes and tolerances?
Are special processes and their controls specified?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
